claims.text: RSF Feb 2026: electricity and internet scarce and costly, internet sometimes ten times the usual cost; shortages of cameras, batteries, phones, safety gear; many in tents; freelancers without contracts and fewer assignments since ceasefire; fuel from ~7 to ~75 shekels; half the territory east of the 'yellow line' inaccessible; three freelancers (Al Sharq TV, AFP) killed by drone 21 Jan 2026; quotes: Dagher 'at breaking point'; Swirki 'we are no longer the main story', 'We are all targets'; Baba 'a struggle for survival', freelancers 'without contracts, without stability and without protection'; al-Moustafa 'We need protection'; RSF: 220+ journalists killed, at least 68 while working or targeted.

RSF Feb 2025: newsrooms and journalists' homes destroyed; Islam al-Zaanoun stopped working for days with no internet or electricity; Bocandé: 'Reporters need multimedia and security equipment, internet and electricity'; exiled journalists cannot return.

13 Apr 2026 CPJ with FPA, Union of Journalists in Israel and RSF filed an emergency motion asking the Supreme Court to expedite a ruling; CPJ: 'There are no substantiated or specific threats against journalists, and journalists pose no threat to Israeli troops.'
21 Jan 2026: army said it struck 'suspects who activated' a Hamas drone threatening troops; details under review.
